source_text: Quid ergo dicemus invenisse Abraham? Si Abraham ex operibus iustificatus est, habet gloriam sed non apud Deum. Credidit Abraham Deo et reputatum est illi ad iustitiam.
pass_a_gloss: What then shall we say Abraham found? If Abraham was justified from works, he has glory but not with God. Abraham believed God and it was counted to him unto righteousness.
pass_b_english: [[If Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about — but not before God >> Bible:Romans 4:2]]. [[Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness >> Bible:Romans 4:3]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
